Shanah Tovah U’Metukah! Wishing you a year filled with health, happiness, and blessing! 🍎🍯

May 5787 bring you and your family abundant blessings, health, nachas, and joy.

A year of growth and strength! From the Altein’s ❤️

We are still riding the high of the Mega Challah Bake last Thursday! 

400 women joined together - kneading, laughing, singing, and connecting. There’s something so powerful about gathering generations of women to celebrate Jewish joy together. 

We are grateful to everyone who joined us, our sponso

One year ago today, we got a precious gift for the New Year. We came back home just in time before the Rosh Hashana candle lighting.
Thank you Hashem for this bundle of love and for the comfort and light he brings to us. We truly needed it so much in the past year.
